title: BoardError
description: S2-007 closed typed error set for the Agent Board and the veritas.execution/1.0.0 boundary. Every failure on this boundary is typed: an exception, timeout, unavailable executor or unknown outcome NEVER collapses into a silent success or into a semantic pass/fail. Code AUTH_REQUIRED, CAPABILITY_MISMATCH, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, AGENT_UNAVAILABLE, TIMEOUT, CANCELLED, MALFORMED_RESULT, UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED are mandatory; the remaining codes are the fail-closed internal conditions. retryable NEVER means 'safe to blind retry': only reconciliation may follow an unknown side effect.

retryable.description: Whether the SAME request may be re-issued after a fresh authorization. False for RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and UNKNOWN_OUTCOME: those require observation or an authorized reconciliation decision, never a blind retry.
